title: UK general election results, 1918-2019
description: Results of every UK general election from 1918 to 2019 by constituency, aggregated to broad Conservative/Liberal/Labour/Nationalist/Other vote shares. Uses the Commons Library's own constituency numbering, not ONS codes, and spans ten different boundary reviews, so it is not yet joined to a boundary map in this atlas.

files.note: Direct file: https://researchbriefings.files.parliament.uk/documents/CBP-8647/1918-2019election_results.csv. Keyed by the Library's own constituency_id, not an ONS/GSS code; no boundary geometry exists yet for the eras before the 2010-2019 boundary set.
